categories.name: Resolve via payment
categories.description: Fine is resolved through payment by the offender, either timely or delinquent after notification and penalty addition.
categories.rationale: Merged timely_payment and delinquent_payment categories per reviewer request.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Fine case involves an administrative appeal process directed to the Prefecture.
categories.rationale: Maps to the declared administrative appeal goal and tasks (id=14 to 18) as observed in variant V0006.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Fine case is contested via a judicial appeal to the Judge.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared task id=19 as observed in variant V0005.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Fine enforcement escalates to coercive credit collection after penalties are added.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared task id=20 as observed in variant V0002.
